question: Durand Cup was founded in the year ________ in Shimla.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1888.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Durand Cup:-**

 
 
• It​ was founded in the year **1888 in Shimla.**
 
• Durand Cup is one of the **oldest football tournaments **in **Asia **and is named after **Sir Mortimer Durand,** who was the Foreign Secretary of British India.
 
• The tournament was initially started as an **Army Cup,** where the British Indian Army teams used to participate.
 
• Later, civilian teams were also** allowed to participate.**
 
• The Durand Cup has been won by top Indian football clubs like Mohun Bagan, East Bengal, and Churchill Brothers, as well as foreign teams like Manchester United and Tottenham Hotspur.
 
• The 2021 edition of the Durand Cup was won by Gokulam Kerala FC, who defeated FC Bengaluru United in the final. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Other tournaments of Football are:-**

 
• **Indian Super League (ISL): **

 
 
• The ISL is India's top-tier professional football league. It was founded in 2013 and currently features 11 teams.
 
• The ISL is held from October to March each year.
 
 
 
• **I-League: **
 
 
• The I-League is India's second-tier professional football league.
 
• It was founded in 2007 and currently features 13 teams.
 
• The I-League is held from November to May each year.
 
 
 
• **Super Cup: **
 
 
• The Super Cup is a knockout football tournament that features the top teams from the ISL and I-League.
 
• It was inaugurated in 2018 and is held annually.
 
 
 
• **IFA Shield: **
 
 
• The IFA Shield is the oldest football tournament in India. It was founded in 1895 and is held annually in Kolkata, West Bengal.
 
 
 
• **Santosh Trophy: **
 
 
• The Santosh Trophy is a knockout football tournament among Indian states.
 
• It was inaugurated in 1941 and is held annually.
